name: Adrien Navarre
source:
Adrien is a famous local artist, and one of the city's many Sirens. Though initially shy upon first meeting, they will quickly and eagerly warm up to you and become a close friend and confidant. You'll find it hard to find someone who doesn't like Adrien, but even harder to find someone who truly knows him.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lunarisgames/call-me-under-a-queer-1950s-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]

Adrien can be romanced on their own or as part of a polyamorous triad with Blue.
